description: A Perl script for modifying Makefile snippets, specifically for adding or fixing hash values and renaming variables within makefiles.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script and exits.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets the variable context based on input, parsing the variable name and related template if applicable.

methods.name: check_context
methods.description: Checks and updates the current parsing context based on the lines in the makefile, looking for define/endef blocks.
